doc: #2176 — red-main-2h quarantine list. One nightly check may be quarantined (skipped by scripts/run-checks.mjs in both modes) while a red main is fixed properly. Every entry MUST name an OPEN issue: {"label": "<npm alias, or alias -- --mutate>", "issue": <n>, "reason": "<one line>"}. Entries without an issue number are ignored (with a warning). Remove the entry in the PR that fixes the check.
